title: Entitled Woman Refuses To Leave Hotel, Goes Away in Cuffs
description:
On August 29th, 2023, officers responded to a verbal disturbance. Upon arriving at the scene, hotel staff informed them that a female guest had been arguing with other guests and they wanted her removed from the premises. The couple continued arguing even after the officer repeatedly requested that they come out of their room. The officer wanted to talk to the woman about the incident. This is when things began escalating. She continued to abuse the officer and be uncooperative. The female was charged with trespass, resisting arrest and battery upon a peace officer.
